title: Govt Debt-to-GDP Ratio Stands at 58.2% in FY26; Fiscal Deficit Drops to 4.4%
summary: India's debt-to-GDP ratio for FY26 stood at 58.2%, 210 bps higher than the 56.1% target, while fiscal deficit declined to 4.4%.

blocks.content: India's debt-to-GDP ratio for FY26 stood at 58.2%, 210 bps higher than the 56.1% target, while fiscal deficit declined to 4.4%.

items: **Debt-to-GDP Ratio:** Government debt-to-GDP ratio for FY26 stood at **58.2%**.
**Target Deviation:** Ratio was **210 basis points (bps)** higher than the government target of **56.1%**.
**Fiscal Deficit Trajectory:** Fiscal deficit dropped significantly from **9.2% in FY21 to 4.4% in FY26**.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Fiscal Deficit Definition: Gap between total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Target Trap:** Note that FY26 debt-to-GDP (58.2%) missed the government aim of 56.1% by 210 bps (2.1%).
